```{r}
#| context: setup
# PROMPT D2 — "Load my shared helpers once per app. Stop with a friendly message
# if the warehouse hasn't been built yet. Read the semantic layer and get the
# filter choices (regions, categories, date range) from DuckDB."
source("R/helpers.R")
library(shiny); library(bslib); library(bsicons); library(plotly); library(DT)

if (!file.exists(proj_path(cfg$duckdb_path)))
  stop("Warehouse not found. Render 01-build-data-layer.qmd first (it builds data/db/).")

layer <- read_semantic()
choices <- with_duck(function(con) list(
  regions    = dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT DISTINCT region FROM dim_depot ORDER BY 1")[[1]],
  categories = dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT DISTINCT category FROM dim_product ORDER BY 1")[[1]],
  dates      = as.Date(unlist(dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT MIN(week_starting), MAX(week_starting) FROM fact_sales"))),
  tables     = dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT table_schema || '.' || table_name AS t FROM information_schema.tables
                                WHERE table_schema IN ('main','landing') ORDER BY table_schema, table_name")[[1]]))

PAL  <- c("#0B2C55", "#E8A33D", "#7FA8D4", "#6FBFAE", "#9B8EC4", "#A9C86B", "#F2C14E", "#E58B3C")
NAVY <- "#0B2C55"; GOLD <- "#E8A33D"
metric_choices <- setNames(names(layer$metrics), vapply(layer$metrics, `[[`, "", "label"))
dim_choices    <- setNames(names(layer$dimensions), vapply(layer$dimensions, `[[`, "", "label"))
plotly_clean   <- function(p) p |> config(displayModeBar = FALSE) |>
  layout(font = list(family = "Inter"), margin = list(t = 10, r = 10), legend = list(orientation = "h"))
```

# {.sidebar width="290px"}

```{r}
# PROMPT D3 — "Sidebar: a source picker (CSV, Excel, Parquet, SQLite, DuckDB,
# PostgreSQL) that marks sources that aren't available on this machine, a date
# range, multi-select region and category filters, and a promotion filter.
# Under the filters, show which source answered and how long it took."
radioButtons("source", "Data source",
  choiceNames  = lapply(names(SOURCES), function(n)
    if (source_available(SOURCES[[n]])) n else tags$span(style = "color:#999", paste(n, "· not configured"))),
  choiceValues = unname(SOURCES), selected = "duckdb")
dateRangeInput("dates", "Weeks", start = choices$dates[1], end = choices$dates[2],
               min = choices$dates[1], max = choices$dates[2])
selectizeInput("regions", "Region", choices$regions, multiple = TRUE, options = list(placeholder = "All regions"))
selectizeInput("categories", "Category", choices$categories, multiple = TRUE, options = list(placeholder = "All categories"))
radioButtons("promo", "Promotion", c("All" = "all", "On promo" = "promo", "Full price" = "nopromo"), inline = TRUE)
hr()
uiOutput("source_info")
```

```{r}
#| title: 1 · Ask in plain English
# PROMPT D6 — "A text box for a business question. When the button is pressed,
```

```{r}
#| title: 2 · Review, edit and run the SQL (read-only)
textAreaInput("ask_sql", NULL, width = "100%", rows = 6, value =
"SELECT depot_name,
       100.0 * AVG(stockout_flag) AS stockout_rate_pct,
       SUM(revenue_ngn)            AS revenue
FROM v_sales
WHERE year(week_starting) = 2025
GROUP BY depot_name
ORDER BY stockout_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 5")
actionButton("ask_run", "Run query", icon = icon("play"), class = "btn-primary")
```

```{r}
#| context: server
# PROMPT D11 — "Server logic. Use reactivePoll on the DuckDB file's modified time
# so every page refreshes itself when refresh.R rebuilds the warehouse, and show
# a notification when that happens. Debounce the filters. Build one reactive
# `sales()` from get_sales(source, filters) and drive every Overview output from
# it through the semantic layer."

# ---- automation: watch the warehouse file -------------------------------
warehouse_stamp <- reactivePoll(cfg$refresh_seconds * 1000, session,
  checkFunc = function() file.mtime(proj_path(cfg$duckdb_path)),
  valueFunc = function() file.mtime(proj_path(cfg$duckdb_path)))
observeEvent(warehouse_stamp(), ignoreInit = TRUE,
  showNotification(paste("Warehouse rebuilt at", format(warehouse_stamp(), "%H:%M:%S"), "— dashboard refreshed"),
                   type = "message", duration = 8))

filters <- reactive(list(dates = input$dates, regions = input$regions,
                         categories = input$categories, promo = input$promo)) |> debounce(400)

timing <- reactiveVal(NA)
sales <- reactive({
  warehouse_stamp()
  validate(need(source_available(input$source),
    "This source isn't configured on this machine. See config.yml and .Renviron.example, or pick another source."))
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  out <- tryCatch(get_sales(input$source, filters()), error = function(e) validate(need(FALSE, conditionMessage(e))))
  timing(round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs")) * 1000))
  validate(need(nrow(out) > 0, "No rows match these filters."))
  out
})
sf <- function(...) semantic_frame(sales(), ..., layer = layer)

output$source_info <- renderUI({
  d <- sales()
  tags$small(tags$b(names(SOURCES)[SOURCES == input$source]), " answered with ",
             format(nrow(d), big.mark = ","), " rows in ", timing(), " ms.", tags$br(),
             "Warehouse built ", format(warehouse_stamp(), "%d %b %Y %H:%M"), ".", tags$br(),
             "Auto-refresh every ", cfg$refresh_seconds, " s.")
})

# ---- Overview -------------------------------------------------------------
output$kpis <- renderUI({
  k <- sf(c("revenue", "gross_margin_pct", "units", "stockout_rate_pct", "promo_share_pct"))
  vb <- function(m, icon, theme) value_box(title = layer$metrics[[m]]$label,
         value = fmt_metric(k[[m]], layer$metrics[[m]]$format), showcase = bs_icon(icon),
         showcase_layout = "left center", theme = theme) |>
         tagAppendAttributes(title = layer$metrics[[m]]$description)
  layout_column_wrap(width = 1/5, fill = TRUE,
    vb("revenue", "cash-coin", value_box_theme(bg = NAVY, fg = "#fff")),
    vb("gross_margin_pct", "percent", value_box_theme(bg = "#F7F4ED", fg = NAVY)),
    vb("units", "box-seam", value_box_theme(bg = "#F7F4ED", fg = NAVY)),
    vb("stockout_rate_pct", "exclamation-triangle", value_box_theme(bg = "#FCEBD7", fg = "#8A4B0F")),
    vb("promo_share_pct", "tags", value_box_theme(bg = GOLD, fg = NAVY)))
})

output$trend <- renderPlotly({
  w <- sf("revenue", grain = "week") |> mutate(rev_m = revenue / 1e6,
        ma4 = as.numeric(stats::filter(rev_m, rep(1/4, 4), sides = 1)))
  plot_ly(w, x = ~period) |>
    add_lines(y = ~rev_m, name = "Weekly", line = list(color = "#7FA8D4", width = 1.5)) |>
    add_lines(y = ~ma4, name = "4-week average", line = list(color = NAVY, width = 3)) |>
    layout(yaxis = list(title = "₦ millions"), xaxis = list(title = "")) |> plotly_clean()
})

output$by_region <- renderPlotly({
  r <- sf(c("revenue", "gross_margin_pct"), "region") |> arrange(revenue)
  plot_ly(r, y = ~factor(region, region), x = ~revenue / 1e9, type = "bar", orientation = "h",
          marker = list(color = NAVY), text = ~sprintf("%.1f%% GM", gross_margin_pct),
          textposition = "inside", insidetextfont = list(color = "#fff"),
          hovertemplate = "%{y}: ₦%{x:.2f}bn<extra></extra>") |>
    layout(xaxis = list(title = "₦ billions"), yaxis = list(title = "")) |> plotly_clean()
})

output$heat <- renderPlotly({
  h <- sf("revenue", c("category", "region"))
  plot_ly(h, x = ~region, y = ~category, z = ~revenue / 1e6, type = "heatmap",
          colors = colorRamp(c("#F7F4ED", "#7FA8D4", NAVY)),
          colorbar = list(title = "₦m"),
          hovertemplate = "%{y} · %{x}: ₦%{z:,.0f}m<extra></extra>") |>
    layout(xaxis = list(title = ""), yaxis = list(title = "")) |> plotly_clean()
})

output$top_products <- renderDT({
  sf(c("revenue", "units", "gross_margin_pct", "stockout_rate_pct", "promo_share_pct"),
     "product_name", limit = 15) |>
    datatable(rownames = FALSE, colnames = c("Product", "Revenue ₦", "Units", "GM %", "Stockout %", "Promo %"),
              options = list(dom = "t", pageLength = 15, scrollY = "100%")) |>
    formatRound(c("revenue", "units"), 0) |>
    formatRound(c("gross_margin_pct", "stockout_rate_pct", "promo_share_pct"), 1) |>
    formatStyle("revenue", background = styleColorBar(c(0, 1), "#E8A33D55"), backgroundSize = "95% 70%",
                backgroundRepeat = "no-repeat", backgroundPosition = "center")
})

# ---- Semantic layer ---------------------------------------------------------
sl_sql <- reactive({
  req(input$sl_metrics)
  compile_metric_sql(layer, input$sl_metrics, input$sl_dims %||% character(), input$sl_grain)
})
sl_data <- reactive(query_frame(sales(), sl_sql()))
output$sl_sql  <- renderUI(tags$pre(class = "sql-out", sl_sql()))
output$sl_defs <- renderUI(tags$small(lapply(input$sl_metrics, function(m)
  tags$p(tags$b(layer$metrics[[m]]$label), ": ", layer$metrics[[m]]$description,
         tags$br(), tags$em("Owner: ", layer$owner)))))
output$sl_table <- renderDT(datatable(sl_data(), rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 12, scrollX = TRUE)) |>
                              formatRound(input$sl_metrics, 1))
output$sl_plot <- renderPlotly({
  d <- sl_data(); m <- input$sl_metrics[1]; dims <- input$sl_dims
  x <- if (input$sl_grain != "none") "period" else if (length(dims)) dims[1] else NULL
  validate(need(!is.null(x), "Pick a time grain or a dimension to chart."))
  colour <- if (input$sl_grain != "none" && length(dims)) dims[1] else if (length(dims) > 1) dims[2] else NULL
  d$grp <- if (is.null(colour)) "All" else as.character(d[[colour]])
  p <- plot_ly(d, x = d[[x]], y = d[[m]], color = ~grp, colors = PAL)
  p <- if (input$sl_chart == "line" && x == "period") add_lines(p) else add_bars(p)
  p |> layout(yaxis = list(title = layer$metrics[[m]]$label), xaxis = list(title = ""), barmode = "group") |> plotly_clean()
})

# ---- Ask your data ----------------------------------------------------------
output$ask_status <- renderUI({
  if (!llm_available()) tags$small(class = "text-muted",
    "AI SQL writer is off: add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to .Renviron, or set llm.provider: ollama in config.yml for a private local model. ",
    "You can still edit and run SQL by hand →")
  else tags$small(class = "text-muted", "Provider: ", cfg$llm$provider, ". The schema and governed metric definitions are sent with your question; your data rows are not.")
})
observeEvent(input$ask_go, {
  validate(need(llm_available(), "No LLM configured"))
  id <- showNotification("Writing SQL…", duration = NULL)
  on.exit(removeNotification(id))
  sql <- tryCatch(ask_llm_for_sql(input$ask_q), error = function(e) paste("-- LLM error:", conditionMessage(e)))
  updateTextAreaInput(session, "ask_sql", value = sql)
})
ask_result <- eventReactive(input$ask_run, {
  warehouse_stamp()
  tryCatch(run_safe_sql(input$ask_sql), error = function(e) validate(need(FALSE, conditionMessage(e))))
}, ignoreNULL = FALSE)
output$ask_table <- renderDT({
  d <- ask_result(); num <- names(d)[vapply(d, is.double, TRUE)]
  dt <- datatable(d, rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE))
  if (length(num)) formatRound(dt, num, 2) else dt
})
output$ask_plot <- renderPlotly({
  d <- ask_result()
  x <- names(d)[!vapply(d, is.numeric, TRUE)][1]; y <- names(d)[vapply(d, is.numeric, TRUE)][1]
  validate(need(!is.na(x) && !is.na(y), "Need one text/date column and one numeric column to chart."))
  p <- plot_ly(d, x = d[[x]], y = d[[y]], marker = list(color = NAVY), line = list(color = NAVY))
  (if (inherits(d[[x]], c("Date", "POSIXct"))) add_lines(p) else add_bars(p)) |>
    layout(xaxis = list(title = x, categoryorder = "trace"), yaxis = list(title = y)) |> plotly_clean()
})

# ---- Customer voice -----------------------------------------------------------
vs <- reactive({ warehouse_stamp(); req(nchar(input$vs_q) > 2); semantic_search(input$vs_q, k = 25) }) |> debounce(500)
output$vs_results <- renderDT({
  d <- vs(); validate(need(!is.null(d), "None of those words appear in the review vocabulary. Try rephrasing (or switch on real embeddings, notebook Step 12)."))
  datatable(d |> select(similarity, review_text, theme, sentiment, channel, star_rating),
            rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 12, dom = "tp")) |>
    formatStyle("similarity", background = styleColorBar(c(0, 1), "#7FA8D466"), backgroundSize = "95% 70%",
                backgroundRepeat = "no-repeat", backgroundPosition = "center") |>
    formatStyle("sentiment", color = styleEqual(c("negative", "neutral", "positive"), c("#B5482A", "#666", "#2E7D6B")))
})
output$vs_theme <- renderPlotly({
  warehouse_stamp()
  d <- with_duck(function(con) dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT theme, sentiment, COUNT(*) n FROM review_docs GROUP BY 1, 2"))
  plot_ly(d, y = ~theme, x = ~n, color = ~sentiment, type = "bar", orientation = "h",
          colors = c(negative = "#E58B3C", neutral = "#C9C3B6", positive = "#6FBFAE")) |>
    layout(barmode = "stack", xaxis = list(title = "reviews"), yaxis = list(title = "", categoryorder = "total ascending")) |> plotly_clean()
})
output$vs_channel <- renderPlotly({
  warehouse_stamp()
  d <- with_duck(function(con) dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT channel, AVG(star_rating) stars, COUNT(*) n FROM review_docs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2"))
  plot_ly(d, x = ~stars, y = ~factor(channel, channel), type = "bar", orientation = "h", marker = list(color = GOLD),
          hovertemplate = "%{y}: %{x:.2f}★<extra></extra>") |>
    layout(xaxis = list(title = "average stars", range = c(1, 5)), yaxis = list(title = "")) |> plotly_clean()
})

# ---- Marketing & macro ----------------------------------------------------------
date_where <- function(col) sprintf("%s BETWEEN DATE '%s' AND DATE '%s'", col, input$dates[1], input$dates[2])
output$mk_bubble <- renderPlotly({
  warehouse_stamp()
  d <- with_duck(function(con) dbGetQuery(con, paste(
    "SELECT channel, SUM(spend_ngn)/1e6 AS spend_m, SUM(conversions) AS conversions,
            SUM(spend_ngn)/NULLIF(SUM(conversions),0) AS cpa
     FROM marketing_spend WHERE", date_where("week_starting"), "GROUP BY channel")))
  plot_ly(d, x = ~spend_m, y = ~conversions, text = ~channel, type = "scatter", mode = "markers+text",
          textposition = "top center", marker = list(size = ~cpa / max(cpa) * 60 + 10, color = PAL[seq_len(nrow(d))], opacity = .8),
          hovertemplate = "%{text}<br>Spend ₦%{x:,.0f}m · %{y:,} conversions<extra></extra>") |>
    layout(xaxis = list(title = "Spend, ₦ millions"), yaxis = list(title = "Conversions"), showlegend = FALSE) |> plotly_clean()
})
output$mk_weekly <- renderPlotly({
  warehouse_stamp()
  d <- with_duck(function(con) dbGetQuery(con, paste(
    "SELECT week_starting, channel, spend_ngn/1e6 AS spend_m FROM marketing_spend WHERE", date_where("week_starting"), "ORDER BY 1")))
  plot_ly(d, x = ~week_starting, y = ~spend_m, color = ~channel, colors = PAL, type = "scatter", mode = "lines", stackgroup = "one") |>
    layout(xaxis = list(title = ""), yaxis = list(title = "₦ millions")) |> plotly_clean()
})
macro <- reactive({ warehouse_stamp(); with_duck(function(con) dbGetQuery(con,
  paste("SELECT * FROM ng_macro_monthly WHERE", date_where("month"), "ORDER BY month"))) })
output$mac_infl <- renderPlotly({
  d <- macro(); validate(need(nrow(d) > 0, "No macro data in this date range."))
  plot_ly(d, x = ~month) |>
    add_lines(y = ~headline_inflation_yoy_pct, name = "Headline CPI", line = list(color = NAVY, width = 2.5)) |>
    add_lines(y = ~food_inflation_yoy_pct, name = "Food CPI", line = list(color = "#E58B3C")) |>
    add_lines(y = ~mpr_pct, name = "MPR", line = list(color = GOLD, dash = "dot")) |>
    layout(xaxis = list(title = ""), yaxis = list(title = "%")) |> plotly_clean()
})
output$mac_fx <- renderPlotly({
  d <- macro(); validate(need(nrow(d) > 0, "No macro data in this date range."))
  plot_ly(d, x = ~month, y = ~usd_ngn_official, type = "scatter", mode = "lines", fill = "tozeroy",
          line = list(color = NAVY), fillcolor = "rgba(127,168,212,.25)") |>
    layout(xaxis = list(title = ""), yaxis = list(title = "₦ per US$")) |> plotly_clean()
})
# PROMPT D8b — "Add official statistics from the warehouse's open_macro table: an IMF WEO
# inflation and growth outlook for Nigeria with projections shaded, and a World Bank WDI
# indicator picker comparing Nigeria with its peers."
open_tbl <- reactive({ warehouse_stamp(); with_duck(function(con)
  if ("open_macro" %in% dbListTables(con)) dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM open_macro") else NULL) })
output$imf_outlook <- renderPlotly({
  d <- open_tbl(); validate(need(!is.null(d), "Render the build notebook to load IMF and World Bank data."))
  d <- subset(d, source == "IMF" & iso3 == "NGA" & indicator %in% c("PCPIPCH", "NGDP_RPCH") & year >= 2015)
  this_year <- as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y"))
  plot_ly(d, x = ~year, y = ~value, color = ~indicator_name, colors = c(NAVY, GOLD), type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers") |>
    layout(shapes = list(list(type = "rect", x0 = this_year - .5, x1 = max(d$year) + .5, y0 = 0, y1 = 1, yref = "paper",
                              fillcolor = "rgba(232,163,61,.12)", line = list(width = 0))),
           annotations = list(list(x = this_year + 1, y = 1, yref = "paper", text = "IMF projection", showarrow = FALSE, font = list(size = 11))),
           xaxis = list(title = ""), yaxis = list(title = "% y/y")) |> plotly_clean()
})
output$wdi_plot <- renderPlotly({
  d <- open_tbl(); validate(need(!is.null(d), "Render the build notebook to load World Bank data."))
  d <- subset(d, source == "World Bank" & indicator == input$wdi_ind)
  plot_ly(d, x = ~year, y = ~value, color = ~country, colors = PAL, type = "scatter", mode = "lines") |>
    layout(xaxis = list(title = ""), yaxis = list(title = d$indicator_name[1])) |> plotly_clean()
})

output$dv_gdp <- renderPlotly({
  warehouse_stamp()
  d <- with_duck(function(con) dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM dv_gdp ORDER BY year"))
  plot_ly(d, x = ~year, y = ~gdp_usd_bn, color = ~country, colors = PAL, type = "scatter", mode = "lines") |>
    layout(xaxis = list(title = ""), yaxis = list(title = "US$ bn")) |> plotly_clean()
})

# ---- Connections ----------------------------------------------------------------------
output$cx_sources <- renderDT({
  warehouse_stamp()
  rows <- lapply(names(SOURCES), function(n) {
    s <- SOURCES[[n]]
    if (!source_available(s)) return(data.frame(source = n, status = "not configured", rows = NA, revenue_bn = NA, ms = NA))
    t0 <- Sys.time(); d <- tryCatch(get_sales(s), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(d)) return(data.frame(source = n, status = "error", rows = NA, revenue_bn = NA, ms = NA))
    data.frame(source = n, status = "live", rows = nrow(d), revenue_bn = round(sum(d$revenue_ngn) / 1e9, 3),
               ms = round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs")) * 1000))
  })
  datatable(do.call(rbind, rows), rownames = FALSE, colnames = c("Source", "Status", "Rows", "Revenue ₦bn", "Load ms"),
            options = list(dom = "t")) |>
    formatStyle("status", fontWeight = "bold", color = styleEqual(c("live", "not configured", "error"), c("#2E7D6B", "#999", "#B5482A")))
})
output$cx_external <- renderDT({
  harvard_cache <- "data/dataverse/harvard_gdp.csv"
  data.frame(
    service = c("Harvard Dataverse", "Microsoft Dataverse", "PostgreSQL", "AI SQL assistant"),
    status  = c(if (file.exists(harvard_cache)) paste("cached", format(file.mtime(harvard_cache), "%d %b %H:%M")) else "not fetched",
                if (msdv_available()) "credentials found" else "add DATAVERSE_URL + Entra app to .Renviron",
                if (pg_available()) paste("host", Sys.getenv("PGHOST")) else "add PGHOST etc. to .Renviron",
                if (llm_available()) cfg$llm$provider else "add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or use ollama")) |>
    datatable(rownames = FALSE, colnames = c("Service", "Status"), options = list(dom = "t"))
})
output$cx_build <- renderUI({
  warehouse_stamp()
  b <- with_duck(function(con) dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM build_log"))
  n <- with_duck(function(con) dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM landing_catalog"))$n
  tags$p(tags$small(icon("database"), " Warehouse built ", tags$b(format(b$built_at, "%d %b %Y %H:%M")), " · ",
                    format(b$fact_rows, big.mark = ","), " fact rows · ", n, " auto-loaded landing tables · ", b$r_version))
})

                                                    test, detail FROM data_tests")) |>

                backgroundColor = styleEqual(c("PASS", "WARN", "FAIL"), c("#6FBFAE", "#E8A33D", "#C2410C")))

output$cx_recon <- renderPlotly({
  warehouse_stamp()
  d <- with_duck(function(con) dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT depot_name, gap_pct FROM recon_regional ORDER BY gap_pct"))
  plot_ly(d, x = ~gap_pct, y = ~factor(depot_name, depot_name), type = "bar", orientation = "h",

          hovertemplate = "%{y}: %{x:.2f}%<extra></extra>") |>

           yaxis = list(title = ""),
           shapes = list(list(type = "line", x0 = 1, x1 = 1, y0 = 0, y1 = 1, yref = "paper", line = list(dash = "dot", color = "#999")),
                         list(type = "line", x0 = -1, x1 = -1, y0 = 0, y1 = 1, yref = "paper", line = list(dash = "dot", color = "#999")))) |>
    plotly_clean()
})
```
